newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Seafresh Q1 pre-tax profit NZ$556,000.
newsitem.headline: Seafresh Q1 pre-tax profit NZ$556,000.

text.p: Seafresh New Zealand Ltd on Friday reported an operating profit of NZ$556,000 before tax for the quarter to December 31, reversing a $420,000 loss in the previous comparable period.
The result did not include an abnormal unrealised gain on investment of NZ$1.5 million, the company said.
"Volumes of fin fish caught to date also indicate that the harvest this year are promising although catches from some deep sea species are not up to expectation," Seafresh said.

It had also advanced plans for expanding joint ventures into Asia. "The company has been involved in discussions in recent weeks and is presently preparing feasibility studies for joint venture partners."
A Malaysian based joint venture company had been formed, it said. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
